title: Russia's constitution recognizes political diversity and a multi-party system
summary: Russia's constitution recognizes political diversity and a multi-party system.
body: The English compilation says political diversity and the multi-party system shall be recognized, that public associations shall be equal before the law, and it continues with a limit on associations whose aims or actions the same passage describes. The source says: "Political diversity and the multi-party system shall be recognized in the Russian Federation." Recognition of a multi-party system and a limit on some associations appear in the same passage. This card does not drop the limit.

sources.title: Constitution of the Russian Federation, Constitute Project English text (Russia 2014 compilation)
